content.title: Is Saturday Night Live New Tonight? Check Out the January 31 Host and Musical Guest
content.text: On one hand, it's already the end of January. On the other, how on earth has January not ended yet? If we're being honest, there's only one thing getting us through the weirdest month of the year: new episodes of Saturday Night Live. How to WatchWatch Saturday Night Live Saturdays at 11:30/10:30c on NBC and next day on Peacock.The comedy show returned from hiatus on January 17 with Host Finn Wolfhard, Musical Guest A$AP Rocky, and surprise appearances from Gaten Matarazzo, Caleb McLaughlin, Sabrina Carpenter, and Jason Momoa. Newly Oscar-nominated Teyana Taylor hosted on January 24 with Musical Guests Geese, helping us to laugh through the cold dark nights of winter. And yet, we're still craving more. Below, find out everything you need to know about the January 31 episode of SNL, and stay tuned to find out what February has in store.RELATED: Watch Alexander Skarsgård's Saturday Night Live Sketches & Monologue from January 31RELATED: Saturday Night Live's Season 51 Cast Members: The Full Lineup for 2025-2026Yes! A new episode of SNL — the third one of 2026, which also just so happens to be the 1000th episode of SNL ever — airs tonight at 11:30/10:30c on NBC and streams the next day on Peacock.RELATED: Stream All 51 Seasons of Saturday Night Live Here RELATED: Every Host of SNL Season 51 for 2025-2026RELATED: Get to Know Every Musical Guest for Saturday Night Live Season 51Who is the January 31 SNL Host and Musical Guest?Alexander Skarsgård and Cardi B. Skarsgård is making his SNL debut in the midst of two movie releases. The Moment, which just hit theaters on January 30, is a mockumentary in which he stars as Charli xcx's tour director. Pillion, premiering on February 6, is a kinky romcom about two bikers. Skarsgård is known for his quirky, unexpected tastes in movies, TV, and fashion, so we're anticipating a weird and wonderful episode tonight. Cardi B is making her grand return to SNL for the first time since she first performed on April 7, 2018. She headlined as Musical Guest with Host Chadwick Boseman and promoted her first album Invasion of Privacy. Now, she's back for her second album, Am I the Drama?During her first episode, the rapper also appeared in the pre-taped sketch "Aidy B & Cardi B," in which Aidy Bryant was inspired by how honest and open the rapper tends to be and decided to channel her confidence.
